files_written: report/assets/qa/*.png (21 QA screenshots, light and dark)
files_not_touched: lab/, results/, tasks/, manifests/, artifacts/, git. report/data/* and report/swarm_replay.html were only regenerated through lab/analyze.py and lab/report_data.py as instructed.

what_was_built.form: Single self-contained page: inline CSS, one inline vanilla JS script, inline SVG charts. No network resources. Loads data/lab.js with a script tag and data/traces_<family>.js lazily by script injection, so it works from file://.
what_was_built.data_driven: Every number is read from window.LAB. The planned condition list comes from LAB.config.conditions, so conditions without episodes are listed as not available yet. Missing or null fields render as 'n/a' or 'not available yet'. Each section renders inside try/catch. The only constant is the size of the original request (10,000 episodes per condition), which is a specification, not a measurement.
sections: Overview: episodes run vs planned, progress, shortfall statement vs original request, errors, retries, model and hardware
Findings (rendered only when LAB.findings_html is present)
Conditions table with per-tensor manifest detail, plus dev sweep table
Results overview: pass rate bars with Wilson intervals, paired difference forest chart with bootstrap intervals, McNemar and Holm p, regressions, improvements, outputs changed
Task-family heatmap with pass rate / difference toggle, cell click filters the trace explorer, difficulty breakdown
Controls: identical-artifact output check, intervention vs matched random control
Behavior metrics: safety by category, calibration, tool use, check-type pass rates, latency and tokens
Generalization dev vs held-out (chart and table when data is present)
Showcased examples (rule-based and analyst), paginated, baseline shown beside condition, label badge and selection rule
Trace explorer: family, condition, difficulty, outcome and text filters, pagination, two-condition side by side comparison, deep link #task=<id>&cond=<cond>
Agent analysis notes and score audit, marked as AI interpretation
Agent swarm numbers, script-worker statement, replay iframe labeled as a replay
what_was_built.charts: dataviz skill followed: condition colors encode type only (baseline aqua, intervention blue, control orange; the first three slots of the reference palette), each condition is identified by a direct row label, legends on every chart, one-hue sequential ramp for pass rate, blue/red diverging ramp with neutral midpoint for differences, values printed in every heat cell, hover and keyboard-focus tooltips, tables beside every chart, separate light and dark values.
